product_from_film: Emdash is an open-source environment for running coding agents in separate tasks and reviewing their changes.
explains_well: The walkthrough links task creation, agent selection, diffs, pull-request controls and checks inside one interface.
unclear: The first issue is left running while other tasks demonstrate completion, so its own change and final result are not followed.
scenario: Assign a Linear issue to Codex, inspect other agent tasks, review changes and show shipping and integration controls.
product_clear_basis: The new-task form visibly combines Codex, isolation options and a Linear issue, then opens agent work.
